parts: Shivaram Venkataraman commented on SPARKR-173
Re: Running wordcount.R from SparkR-pkg examples package

Spark requires a fully qualified HDFS file name so hdfs://localhost:54310/user/sukla/wordcount/input/file01 should be the right way to call it
The error message "org.apache.hadoop.ipc.RemoteException: Server IPC version 9 cannot communicate with client version 4" indicates that the HDFS version SparkR is linked to is different from the HDFS version that is running. You can change the Hadoop version SparkR uses by passing a flag while building (as described in https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg#package-installation)

Re: Running wordcount.R from SparkR-pkg examples package

I have solved it now. I checked your install-dev.sh file & found that you are creating the SparkR package under the lib directory of SparkR-pkg. So I copied the SparkR directory under lib to the site-library directory of R & now wordcount is running fine under the R shell also.

Thanks
